title: Battle of Sierra Bullones
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Sierra Bullones", at revision 1370589345, opens: "The Battle of Sierra de Bullones was the first big battle between Spain and Morocco during the Hispano-Moroccan War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q11908785, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle of the Hispano–Moroccan War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
